title: Format with YADF
summary: Reformats one Pascal unit by driving the external YADF formatter
intro: Read this when you want one unit reformatted by the YADF formatter. Careful: drag-lint format rewrites the file in place; try --diff (formats a copy and prints the diff) or --dry-run first, and commit before running it for real.

steps: Open the unit in the editor
The unit is rewritten in place by YADF

surfaces.usage: drag-lint format <file> [--yadf-path PATH] [--dry-run] [--diff] (rewrites the file IN PLACE via YADF; --dry-run resolves + version-checks and writes nothing, --diff formats a copy and prints the diff. Refuses YADF older than 1.0.6.6 (exit 4) and restores the file if formatting changes what the unit declares (exit 5). Exit 0 also when YADF declines the file (its content guard leaves it unchanged; prints "Declined: <file>", not a failure))

questions.ask: How do I reformat one unit with YADF?
Can I check what it would do without writing?
